module: Flowgraph node "Drift Veh" (category repeat_instant, drift). Sets the reference vehicle of the drift module; without a specified id, the player vehicle is used. Inputs: setVehId (pulse) and vehId. Output: current vehId (gameplay_drift_drift.getVehId()).

work.desc: On the setVehId pulse calls gameplay_drift_drift.setVehId(vehId); always writes the current id to the output.
